title: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in video generation have made synthetic videos increasingly realistic, placing greater demands on reliable AI-generated video detection. Existing artifact-based detectors typically identify generation artifacts as evidence for source prediction, yet they may either fail to recognize subtle artifacts or reach the correct source decision without faithfully identifying the evidence underlying it. In this work, we systematically investigate how to design and train effective artifact detectors and formulate artifact detection as a structured process comprising three complementary capabilities: Inspection Planning , which determines what should be examined; Evidence Verification , which verifies whether the inspected content exhibits genuine generation artifacts; and Evidence Aggregation , which integrates the verified evidence into the final source decision. Building on this formulation, we introduce Verus-Insight , trained with human-anchored full-process supervision and progressive capability training to strengthen both fine-grained artifact detection and video-level detection. We further introduce Verus-Bench , a benchmark with fine-grained human annotations of perceptible artifacts for evaluating artifact detection. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Verus-Insight achieves strong performance in both fine-grained artifact analysis and AI-generated video detection, with substantial gains in recovering human-perceived artifacts. Further analyses reveal that the three capabilities are complementary yet distinct, and that Verus-Insight more reliably converts relevant inspection targets into supported artifact evidence without increasing spurious artifact claims.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成领域的最新进展使合成视频日益逼真，对可靠的AI生成视频检测提出了更高要求。 现有的基于伪影的检测器通常将生成伪影识别为来源预测的证据，但它们可能既无法识别细微的伪影，也可能在没有如实识别其背后证据的情况下就做出正确的来源判断。 在本工作中，我们系统地研究了如何设计和训练有效的伪影检测器，并将伪影检测形式化为一个由三种互补能力组成的结构化过程：检查规划，决定应检查哪些内容；证据验证，验证被检查内容是否表现出真实的生成伪影；以及证据聚合，将经过验证的证据整合到最终的来源判断中。 基于这一形式化框架，我们提出了 Verus-Insight，它通过以人为锚点的全流程监督和渐进式能力训练来增强细粒度伪影检测和视频级检测两种能力。 我们进一步提出了 Verus-Bench，这是一个包含可感知伪影的细粒度人工标注的基准，用于评估伪影检测。 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，Verus-Insight 在细粒度伪影分析和AI生成视频检测两方面均取得了出色性能，在恢复人类可感知伪影方面有显著提升。 进一步的分析揭示，这三种能力既互补又各有区别，并且 Verus-Insight 能够更可靠地将相关检查目标转化为有依据的伪影证据，而不会增加虚假的伪影判断。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in video generation [ 9 , 13 , 27 , 24 , 16 , 35 ] have substantially improved the realism and diversity of synthetic videos, making them increasingly difficult to distinguish from real ones. Reliable AI-generated video detection has therefore become important for applications such as content authenticity verification, generation quality evaluation, and provenance and safety analysis [ 25 ] . A prevailing approach is to identify generation artifacts as evidence for source determination, with recent methods increasingly leveraging multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to recognize such artifacts and determine whether a video is real or AI-generated [ 14 , 23 , 31 ] .

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, existing detectors still struggle to reliably identify the specific artifacts present in a video. They may overlook subtle spatiotemporal abnormalities or mistake normal visual phenomena for generation artifacts [ 14 ] , while coarse or superficial analysis can further limit their ability to recognize concrete generation errors [ 23 ] . As illustrated in Figure 1 , even a correct source prediction can accompany inaccurate or incomplete artifact identification. These failures limit the usefulness of detectors for diagnosing specific problems in generated videos. Reliable artifact detection therefore requires targeted inspection of the video content and careful discrimination between genuine abnormalities and normal observations. This motivates training detectors to identify what should be checked in each video and determine, from the corresponding visual evidence, whether an artifact is actually present.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，现有的检测器仍难以可靠地识别视频中出现的具体伪影。 它们可能忽略细微的时空异常，或将正常的视觉现象误判为生成伪影 [ 14 ]，而粗浅或表面的分析会进一步限制它们识别具体生成错误的能力 [ 23 ]。 如图 1 所示，即使是正确的来源预测，也可能伴随不准确或不完整的伪影识别。 这些失败限制了检测器在诊断生成视频中具体问题方面的实用性。 因此，可靠的伪影检测需要对视频内容进行有针对性的检查，并在真实的异常与正常的观察之间进行细致的区分。 这促使我们训练检测器识别每个视频中应当检查的内容，并根据相应的视觉证据判断伪影是否真实存在。

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we systematically investigate how to design and train effective artifact detectors for AI-generated videos. As illustrated in Figure 1 , we formulate artifact detection as a structured process comprising three complementary stages: Inspection Planning , which determines what to examine; Evidence Verification , which verifies whether the inspected content exhibits generation artifacts; and Evidence Aggregation , which integrates the verified evidence into the final source decision. This decomposition allows us to explicitly examine and strengthen the capabilities underlying the detection process. Building on this formulation, we introduce Verus-Insight , trained with human-anchored full-process supervision and progressive capability training to improve both fine-grained artifact identification and video-level source detection. We further introduce Verus-Bench , a benchmark with fine-grained human annotations of perceptible artifacts for evaluation beyond video-level source prediction.

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that Verus-Insight achieves strong performance in both fine-grained artifact analysis and video-level AI-generated content detection across diverse benchmarks. Our analyses further reveal that Inspection Planning , Evidence Verification , and Evidence Aggregation are complementary yet distinct: relevant inspection targets do not always translate into correctly recovered artifacts, while accurate source predictions may still rely on incomplete artifact evidence. Notably, Verus-Insight more reliably converts relevant inspection targets into supported artifact findings without increasing spurious artifact reporting, with gains generalizing across datasets and artifact conditions. These findings highlight the importance of strengthening both individual capabilities and their connections beyond optimizing source prediction alone.

paragraphs.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) [ 19 , 28 , 2 , 29 , 36 , 22 , 20 ] integrate visual perception with language reasoning, with recent models supporting increasingly capable video understanding [ 2 , 21 , 18 , 30 , 11 ] . Their ability to describe visual content and reason about temporal events motivates explainable video authenticity assessment: LOKI evaluates general-purpose MLLMs on synthetic-content detection and anomaly explanation [ 34 ] , while LAVID augments detection with explicit knowledge [ 15 ] . Despite advances in general video understanding, evaluations of general-purpose MLLMs reveal persistent limitations in identifying subtle generative artifacts and grounding them in precise spatiotemporal evidence [ 25 , 14 , 5 , 6 ] , motivating specialized training and evidence-level evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）[19, 28, 2, 29, 36, 22, 20] 将视觉感知与语言推理相结合，近期的模型已支持日益强大的视频理解能力 [2, 21, 18, 30, 11]。 这些模型描述视觉内容并推理时间事件的能力，推动了可解释视频真实性评估的发展：LOKI 在合成内容检测与异常解释任务上评估通用多模态大语言模型 [34]，而 LAVID 则通过显式知识增强检测能力 [15]。 尽管通用视频理解取得了进展，但对通用多模态大语言模型的评估表明，它们在识别细微的生成式伪影并将其定位于精确的时空证据方面仍存在持续性的局限 [25, 14, 5, 6]，这促使了专门化训练与证据级评估的发展。

sents.en: Despite advances in general video understanding, evaluations of general-purpose MLLMs reveal persistent limitations in identifying subtle generative artifacts and grounding them in precise spatiotemporal evidence [ 25 , 14 , 5 , 6 ] , motivating specialized training and evidence-level evaluation.
sents.zh: 尽管通用视频理解取得了进展，但对通用多模态大语言模型的评估表明，它们在识别细微的生成式伪影并将其定位于精确的时空证据方面仍存在持续性的局限 [25, 14, 5, 6]，这促使了专门化训练与证据级评估的发展。

paragraphs.en: Recent methods extend authenticity classification toward interpretable artifact analysis, providing increasingly detailed explanations. However, the final verdict correctness remains an incomplete measure of diagnostic quality: a correct real/fake prediction neither establishes coverage of human-perceived artifacts nor validates the spatiotemporal basis of each claim. BusterX++ combines classification rewards with response-level thinking assessment, without explicitly measuring artifact coverage or verifying the spatiotemporal grounding of individual claims [ 31 ] . DeeptraceReward learns from human-annotated artifacts and evaluates explanations and localization, but its aggregate scoring does not require each claim to be jointly correct in semantics, space, and time [ 5 ] . Skyra combines human-annotated grounding supervision with reinforcement learning, but its inspection reward merely counts formatted evidence blocks without directly verifying their faithfulness [ 14 ] . VideoVeritas strengthens perception through grounding and counting pretext tasks, while its detection-stage rewards only focus on classification accuracy and output format rather than artifact-level coverage and grounding [ 23 ] . Ivy-xDetector learns explanatory detection and evaluates textual similarity and overall explanation quality, but these measures do not directly establish whether individual claims correspond to correctly localized artifacts [ 12 ] . TUE-Detector learns tool-mediated evidence collection, yet its classification and trajectory-structure rewards do not directly verify whether the collected evidence comprehensively and accurately captures human-perceived artifacts [ 32 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近期方法将真伪分类扩展到可解释的伪影分析，提供日益详细的解释。 然而，最终判定结果的正确性仍是对诊断质量的不完整衡量：正确的真/假预测既不能保证覆盖人类感知到的伪影，也不能验证每条论断的时空依据。 BusterX++ 将分类奖励与响应级思维评估相结合，但未显式度量伪影覆盖度或验证单条论断的时空定位依据 [ 31 ] 。 DeeptraceReward 从人工标注的伪影中学习，并评估解释与定位，但其聚合评分并不要求每条论断在语义、空间和时间上同时正确 [ 5 ] 。 Skyra 将人工标注的定位监督与强化学习相结合，但其检查奖励仅统计格式化的证据块数量，而未直接验证其忠实性 [ 14 ] 。 VideoVeritas 通过定位和计数前置任务增强感知能力，而其检测阶段的奖励仅关注分类准确率和输出格式，而非伪影级别的覆盖与定位 [ 23 ] 。 Ivy-xDetector 学习解释性检测并评估文本相似度和整体解释质量，但这些指标并未直接确认单条论断是否对应于被正确定位的伪影 [ 12 ] 。 TUE-Detector 学习借助工具收集证据，但其分类和轨迹结构奖励并未直接验证所收集的证据是否全面且准确地捕捉了人类感知到的伪影 [ 32 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Capability Formulation. Inspection Planning determines what to inspect by identifying content-specific properties of the input video that warrant closer examination. Evidence Verification examines these inspection targets to determine whether they exhibit genuine generation artifacts and recovers the corresponding visual evidence with temporal and spatial support when available. Evidence Aggregation then integrates the verified evidence into the final real/AI-generated prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 能力表述。 检查规划通过识别输入视频中值得进一步审视的特定内容属性，来确定需要检查哪些内容。 证据验证对这些检查目标进行审视，判断它们是否表现出真实的生成伪影，并在可用时恢复具有时间和空间支持的相应视觉证据。 证据聚合随后将经验证的证据整合为最终的真实/AI 生成预测。

paragraphs.en: Capability-Level Measures. Following this decomposition, we evaluate inspection coverage, artifact recovery, and source prediction. Plan F1 measures whether the model covers inspection targets associated with salient human-perceived artifacts, while Finding F1 measures whether these artifacts are recovered; both use one-to-one semantic matching. Unmatched predicted findings, including those on real videos, count as false positives. Balanced Accuracy (BA) evaluates video-level source detection by averaging recall over the real and AI-generated classes. Detailed matching and evaluation protocols are provided in Appendix A.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 能力层级的度量指标。 基于这一分解，我们评估检查覆盖率、痕迹恢复与来源预测。 Plan F1 衡量模型是否覆盖了与显著的人类可感知痕迹相关联的检查目标，而 Finding F1 衡量这些痕迹是否被恢复出来；两者均采用一对一语义匹配。 未匹配上的预测发现（包括针对真实视频的预测发现）计为假阳性。 平衡准确率（BA）通过在真实与 AI 生成两类上取召回率的平均值来评估视频级来源检测。 详细的匹配与评估协议见附录 A.4。

paragraphs.en: Learn Inspection Planning with Explicit Rubrics. Effective inspection must adapt to the content of each video, as different objects, interactions, and dynamics expose different potential failure modes. We therefore represent the inspection plan as a sample-specific, outcome-neutral rubric , where each criterion specifies what should be examined without presupposing whether an artifact is present. We study both rubric-specific warm-up and explicit rubric generation during the full detection process. As shown in Table 1 (a), either component alone yields uneven gains, whereas their combination consistently performs best across all three metrics. These results suggest that learning the planning capability and explicitly exposing the resulting plan serve complementary roles. We therefore learn rubric planning and preserve the generated rubrics as the interface between Inspection Planning and Evidence Verification . More Details about the development set are in Appendix A.1.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 通过显式评分标准学习检查规划。 有效的检查必须适应每个视频的内容，因为不同的对象、交互和动态会暴露出不同的潜在失败模式。 因此，我们将检查规划表示为针对具体样本、与结果无关的评分标准，其中每条准则规定应检查的内容，而不预设伪影是否存在。 我们在完整检测过程中同时研究了针对特定评分标准的热身和显式的评分标准生成。 如表1（a）所示，任一组件单独使用时带来的提升并不均衡，而二者的结合在全部三项指标上始终表现最佳。 这些结果表明，学习规划能力与显式呈现所得规划起着互补作用。 因此，我们学习评分标准规划，并保留生成的评分标准，将其作为检查规划与证据验证之间的接口。 关于开发集的更多细节见附录A.1.3。

paragraphs.en: Strengthen Evidence Verification with Fine-Grained Perception. Reliable verification requires resolving subtle artifact evidence at the appropriate spatial location and temporal extent. We compare observation, localization, and region tracking as progressively more structured perceptual warm-up tasks, together with whether spatiotemporal grounding remains explicit during the full detection process. As shown in Table 1 (b), region tracking combined with explicit grounding achieves the best overall performance, indicating that fine-grained perceptual supervision and an explicit grounding interface are complementary for reliable evidence verification. Accordingly, we adopt region tracking for perceptual warm-up and retain explicit spatiotemporal grounding during Evidence Verification.

paragraphs.en: Step 0: Data Collection and Annotation. Following prior work [ 25 ] , we collect publicly available AI-generated videos from recent models, including Kling-2.5 [ 13 ] , Veo 3 [ 9 ] , HunyuanVideo-1.5 [ 26 ] , LTX-2.3 [ 10 ] , and Wan2.2 [ 27 ] . Real videos are sourced from NExT-QA [ 33 ] , OneThinker-STVG [ 4 ] , DiDeMo [ 1 ] , and the Internet. Human annotators identify perceptible artifacts and record their categories, descriptions, and spatiotemporal evidence. We combine the training split with RewardData [ 5 ] to construct the full-process supervision below. See Appendix A.1.1 for details.

paragraphs.en: Step 1: Artifact-Anchored Criterion Construction. As shown in Figure 3 , we begin with human annotations of perceptible artifacts, each specifying the artifact type, observed abnormality, and its temporal and spatial support when available. For each annotation, we construct a linked criterion-verification pair. The observed failure is first transformed into a sample-specific, outcome-neutral rubric criterion that specifies what property should be inspected without revealing whether it is anomalous. The original human annotation is then retained as the corresponding verification target, preserving the observed abnormality and its available temporal and spatial evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤一：基于伪影的准则构建。 如图3所示，我们从人类对可感知伪影的标注开始，每次标注均指明伪影类型、观察到的异常情况，以及在可用时的其时间与空间支持信息。 对于每一条标注，我们构建一个相互关联的准则—验证对。 观察到的失败首先被转化为一个针对样本的、结果中立的评分准则，该准则说明应检查什么属性，但不揭示其是否异常。 随后保留原始的人工标注作为对应的验证目标，以保留观察到的异常及其可用的时间与空间证据。

paragraphs.en: Step 2: Verified-Normal Criterion Augmentation. Using only artifact-anchored criteria would create a shortcut: if every criterion corresponded to a known failure, its presence would implicitly reveal the verification outcome. We therefore augment each rubric with verified-normal criteria. Candidate checks are proposed for visually meaningful objects, interactions, and temporal relations, and retained only when independent verification confirms that the inspection target is valid and the corresponding visual evidence supports a normal observation. The resulting rubric thus contains both artifact-anchored and verified-normal inspection targets, preventing the criterion itself from revealing whether an artifact is present.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤二：经验证正常准则增广。 仅使用伪影锚定准则会造成捷径：如果每条准则都对应一个已知失败，其存在本身就会隐含地揭示验证结果。 因此，我们用经验证正常准则来增广每份评分细则。 针对具有视觉意义的对象、交互和时间关系提出候选检查项，只有当独立验证确认检查目标有效且相应的视觉证据支持正常观察时才予以保留。 由此得到的评分细则同时包含伪影锚定和经验证正常的检查目标，从而防止准则本身泄露是否存在伪影。

paragraphs.en: Step 3: Full-Process Trajectory Assembly. Finally, we organize the retained criterion-verification pairs into a training trajectory. We prepend a label-neutral video description and high-level inspection domains, followed by the sample-specific rubric and its criterion-linked verification results. The linked pairs are jointly shuffled while preserving their correspondence, preventing positional cues from revealing verification outcomes. The verified observations are then summarized through Evidence Aggregation, without introducing additional artifact claims, before producing the final source decision. This construction provides supervision for the complete inspection-verification-aggregation process while keeping intermediate judgments grounded in human-anchored visual evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤3：全流程轨迹组装。 最后，我们将保留的准则-验证对组织成训练轨迹。 我们在开头添加与标签无关的视频描述和高层级检测领域，随后是样本特定的评分准则及其与准则关联的验证结果。 关联的对在保持对应关系的同时被联合打乱，防止位置线索泄露验证结果。 随后，已验证的观察通过证据聚合进行总结，且不引入额外的伪影声明，之后得出最终的来源判定。 这一构造为完整的检测-验证-聚合过程提供了监督，同时使中间判断立足于以人为锚定的视觉证据。

paragraphs.en: Stage I: Tracking & Rubric Planning Warm-up. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, we jointly train region tracking and rubric planning with a 1:1 sampling ratio. Given an initial bounding box, tracking predicts the target location at queried timestamps, strengthening the spatiotemporal perception required for Evidence Verification. paragraphs.en: We construct Verus-Bench for fine-grained evaluation of AI-generated video artifact detection. The benchmark includes diverse real-world videos from NExT-QA [ 33 ] , OneThinker-STVG [ 4 ] , DiDeMo [ 1 ] , and our collection from the Internet. We independently collect AI-generated videos from the Internet and annotate them following the same protocol as training data. These videos remain sample-disjoint from the training and development sets. The collection covers recent high-quality generation models and emphasizes subtle, localized, and transient artifacts. Annotators perform dense frame-by-frame inspection to identify salient, human-perceivable artifacts, with each annotation specifying a concise observation, its temporal extent, and frame-wise bounding boxes of the affected region. All annotations undergo manual quality review. Detailed data sources, collection procedures, and statistics are provided in Appendix A.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 Verus-Bench，用于对 AI 生成视频的伪影检测进行细粒度评估。 该基准包含来自 NExT-QA [33]、OneThinker-STVG [4]、DiDeMo [1] 以及我们从互联网收集的多样化真实世界视频。 我们独立地从互联网收集 AI 生成视频，并按照与训练数据相同的协议进行标注。 这些视频与训练集和开发集在样本上互不重叠。 该收集涵盖了近期高质量的生成模型，并侧重于细微的、局部的和瞬态的伪影。 标注者逐帧进行密集检查，以识别人类可感知的显著伪影，每条标注都包含一个简洁的观察描述、其时间范围以及受影响区域的逐帧边界框。 所有标注均经过人工质量审查。 详细的数据来源、收集流程和统计数据见附录 A.1。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Benchmarks. We evaluate Verus-Insight along two complementary tracks: video-level AI-generated content detection , which determines whether a video is AI-generated based on artifact evidence, and fine-grained artifact analysis , which identifies the specific artifacts present in the video. For video-level detection, we use Artifact-Bench [ 25 ] , RewardData [ 5 ] , ViF-Bench [ 14 ] , and Verus-Bench, covering diverse video sources and generation models. For fine-grained artifact analysis, we use Verus-Bench and RewardData [ 5 ] , both of which provide human-annotated artifact references for evaluating inspection planning and artifact finding. We further evaluate fine-grained generalization on ViF-CoT-4K subset [ 14 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 评测基准。 我们沿着两条互补的轨道评估 Verus-Insight：视频级AI生成内容检测，即基于伪影证据判断一段视频是否为AI生成；以及细粒度伪影分析，即识别视频中存在的具体伪影。 在视频级检测方面，我们使用 Artifact-Bench [ 25 ] 、RewardData [ 5 ] 、ViF-Bench [ 14 ] 和 Verus-Bench，涵盖多样的视频来源和生成模型。 在细粒度伪影分析方面，我们使用 Verus-Bench 和 RewardData [ 5 ] ，二者均提供了人工标注的伪影参考，用于评估检查规划和伪影发现。 我们进一步在 ViF-CoT-4K 子集 [ 14 ] 上评估细粒度泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Fine-Grained Inspection Planning and Artifact Finding. We next examine whether these video-level gains are accompanied by stronger artifact-level analysis. As shown in Table 3 , Verus-Insight consistently improves both Plan F1 and Finding F1 over its Qwen3-VL-8B backbone. On Verus-Bench, Plan F1 increases from 17.08 to 24.70 and Finding F1 from 7.56 to 15.97; on RewardData, Plan F1 rises from 18.67 to 31.33, while Finding F1 increases markedly from 3.38 to 35.42. Verus-Insight outperforms all evaluated specialized detectors in both Plan F1 and Finding F1 on both benchmarks, and achieves the highest Finding F1 among all evaluated models on RewardData. The improvement is particularly pronounced in artifact finding. On RewardData, Finding precision and recall jointly increase from 1.87/18.13 to 33.66/37.36, indicating that the gain is not simply obtained by producing more artifact claims: Verus-Insight recovers more human-perceived artifacts while substantially improving the precision of its findings. Together, these results show that Verus-Insight improves not only the final real/fake decision, but also the intermediate process of identifying what to inspect and recovering concrete artifact evidence. This alignment between fine-grained artifact analysis and video-level detection supports our premise that reliable artifact evidence can provide an effective basis for AI-generated video detection.

paragraphs.en: Q2: Verus-Insight More Effectively Converts Plans into Artifact Findings. Q1 shows that Inspection Planning does not necessarily lead to successful Evidence Verification. To quantify this transition, we define Plan-to-Evidence Conversion , P ⁡ ( F = 1 ∣ P = 1 ) P(F=1\mid P=1) , where P = 1 P=1 indicates that a reference artifact is covered by a matched inspection target and F = 1 F=1 that the same artifact is recovered by a matched finding. As shown in Fig. 5 (a), Verus-Insight improves the conversion rate from 45.16% to 54.88% on Verus-Bench and from 30.48% to 75.58% on RewardData, despite lower Plan recall than the backbone. This indicates that the gains arise from more reliably converting covered inspection targets into artifact findings, rather than simply increasing inspection coverage.
paragraphs.zh: Q2：Verus-Insight 更有效地将计划转化为工件发现。 Q1 表明检查规划并不一定会带来成功的证据验证。 为了量化这一转化过程，我们定义了计划到证据转化率 P ⁡ ( F = 1 ∣ P = 1 ) P(F=1\mid P=1)，其中 P = 1 P=1 表示参考工件被某个匹配的检查目标所覆盖，而 F = 1 F=1 表示同一工件被某个匹配的发现所恢复。 如图 5 (a) 所示，尽管其计划召回率低于骨干模型，Verus-Insight 在 Verus-Bench 上将转化率从 45.16% 提升至 54.88%，在 RewardData 上从 30.48% 提升至 75.58%。 这表明增益来自更可靠地将被覆盖的检查目标转化为工件发现，而不是仅仅增加检查的覆盖率。

paragraphs.en: We presented Verus-Insight , an artifact detection framework that decomposes AI-generated video detection into Inspection Planning, Evidence Verification, and Evidence Aggregation. Through human-anchored full-process supervision and progressive capability training, Verus-Insight improves both fine-grained artifact recovery and video-level detection. We further introduced Verus-Bench , which provides fine-grained human annotations of perceptible artifacts and their spatiotemporal evidence for evaluating artifact detection. Our design studies highlight the value of combining targeted capability supervision with explicit inspection criteria and spatiotemporal grounding. Further analyses show that inspection coverage, artifact recovery, and source prediction are related but distinct, and that Verus-Insight more reliably converts relevant inspections into accurate artifact findings while limiting spurious artifact claims. Together, these findings motivate training and evaluating future artifact detectors as evidence-grounded inspection systems that connect content-specific inspection, concrete visual evidence, and final source decisions.

paragraphs.en: We ensure that Analysis-Dev is sample-disjoint from this study’s training data and final test sets by checking original parent-video identities, paths, and frame content. We reuse existing ground-truth annotations: selected AI-generated RewardData videos must include original artifact explanations, and selected AI-generated ViF-CoT videos must each have exactly one explicitly annotated finding. No annotations are regenerated or manually split. paragraphs.en: A joint extractor reads each complete answer without videos or GT and returns checks, affirmative findings, and verbatim supporting evidence. A check can be expressed as an inspected property, a normal judgment, a suspicion, a proposed inspection, or an affirmative abnormal observation. In particular, an affirmative finding can establish a Plan check even when no separate plan is emitted. Repeated mentions of the same target and property are merged into one check. Character ranges are validated programmatically, and each Finding’s evidence must lie within its parent Plan check’s evidence. For these models, Plan F1 measures inspection coverage recoverable from the response; it does not require an explicit plan preceding the finding. Both representations are evaluated against the same reference inspection targets with the matching rules below.

paragraphs.en: Plan matching requires the same target/event and specific inspection property, regardless of normal, abnormal, or uncertain polarity.
